__1 N. of a female fiend, daughter of Suketu, wife of Sunda and mother of Mārīcha. [She was changed into a fiend by the sage Agastya whose devotions she had disturbed. She was killed by Rāma when she began to disturb, the sacrificial rites of Viśvā -mitra. Rāma was first unwilling to bend his bow, against a woman, but the sage overcame his scruples. See [[
[ताडकाया अपत्यं ढक्] An epithet of the demon Mārīcha, son of Tāḍakā.
